name: p1-refused-zipdma-two-channel-profile
description: Refusal sample: the same four-word block selected through a profile whose own capabilities block declares two channels and an eight-byte beat. The planner refuses the profile against its pinned device facts by name.
notes: This scenario exists to record the profile-side refusal, not to pass. The profile is a declaration-only copy of configs/peripherals/zipdma_smoke/component_profile.json whose capabilities block adds channels 2 and beat_bytes 8; every other byte is identical, and the selected RTL is the same pinned ZipDMA.
The refusal is dma-profile-capability-beyond-device:zipdma:channels:2>1, raised by the planner when it cross-checks the profile against its pinned device facts.
The capability path in this scenario names shared_profile_dma only to reach the planner; the refusal fires before any capability or transfer is admitted, so nothing is executed.

No dma_capability is named: the refusal happens in the planner, before any capability document is admitted, so naming one here would only add a second check in front of the one this scenario exists to record.
